security_audit.summary: Most static command and reconnaissance findings are Markdown examples or documentation headings, not executable or reconnaissance behavior. The confirmed issue is that each Python helper can write a JSON report to an unrestricted user-supplied output path. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Constrain --output to the project workspace, warn before overwrite, and refuse known sensitive paths such as .env files.
Label package, Docker, Kubernetes, and deployment commands as examples that require explicit user confirmation before execution.
Clarify that .env.example should only seed a new local .env file and must not overwrite an existing secrets file.

content.value_statement: DevOps teams need repeatable guidance for pipelines, infrastructure, deployments, and monitoring. This skill provides structured references and helper scripts for planning and scaffolding safer workflows.
actual_capabilities: Documents CI/CD pipeline setup, infrastructure as code, deployment strategies, and monitoring topics.
Provides Python helper scripts for pipeline generation, Terraform scaffolding, and deployment reporting.
Validates target paths before running script analysis.
Can print script results to the console or write JSON report files.
Links reference guides covering patterns, guidelines, anti-patterns, and troubleshooting.
limitations: The helper scripts are scaffolds and do not generate complete production infrastructure.
Cloud provider examples are high level and need team-specific security review.
Deployment commands are examples and should not run without user confirmation.
The scripts do not inspect live cloud accounts or CI systems by default.

use_cases.title: Plan a CI/CD Baseline
use_cases.description: Review repository needs and outline a pipeline with build, test, quality, and deployment stages.

use_cases.title: Standardize IaC Practices
use_cases.description: Use the Terraform scaffolding guidance to align modules, environments, reviews, and drift checks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Compare deployment strategies and build a checklist for rollback, monitoring, and approval gates.

prompt_templates.title: Review a DevOps Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my repository structure and suggest a CI/CD setup using this skill. Focus on safe defaults and required manual approvals.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Pipeline Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CI/CD pipeline plan for my service. Include stages, quality checks, secrets handling, and deployment approval points.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Terraform Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess my Terraform layout for environment separation, module boundaries, state handling, and review controls. Recommend practical improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Release Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare blue-green, canary, and rolling deployments for my application. Recommend a rollout, monitoring plan, and rollback procedure.

output_examples.input: Review a Node.js service for CI/CD readiness.
output_examples.output: A staged pipeline plan with install, test, lint, build, artifact, deployment, approval, and monitoring checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Plan Terraform scaffolding for three environments.
output_examples.output: A module and environment outline with state isolation, variable handling, review gates, and drift detection notes.

output_examples.input: Choose a deployment strategy for a customer-facing API.
output_examples.output: A comparison of rollout options with recommended canary steps, health signals, rollback criteria, and ownership notes.

best_practices: Review generated scripts and examples before running commands that change infrastructure.
Use separate cloud credentials and approval gates for development, staging, and production.
Commit generated configuration through normal code review with security and rollback checks.
anti_patterns: Running deployment commands from examples without checking the target cluster or account.
Writing script output to sensitive paths or shared configuration files.
Treating scaffolded guidance as a replacement for security and compliance review.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy infrastructure automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, examples, and helper scripts. Confirm every command before changing cloud or Kubernetes resources.

faq.question: Can it work with AWS, GCP, and Azure?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill description covers all three platforms, but examples are general and need provider-specific review.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: The included scripts do not make network requests. Some example commands may use package managers or deployment tools.

faq.question: Can it generate Terraform modules?
faq.answer: It provides a Terraform scaffolder script and infrastructure guidance. Review all generated work before using it.

faq.question: Is it safe for production use?
faq.answer: Use it for planning and scaffolding. Production changes need approvals, backups, tests, and rollback plans.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
